query:
SELECT om.user_id
             FROM organization_memberships om
             INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = om.user_id
             LEFT JOIN crm_user_mappings existing
               ON existing.organization_id = om.organization_id
              AND existing.user_id = om.user_id
              AND existing.provider = $2::text::crm_provider
              AND existing.crm_tenant_id = $3
             WHERE om.organization_id = $1
               AND om.status = 'ACTIVE'
               AND lower(u.email) = lower($4)
               AND (
                    existing.id IS NULL
                    OR (
                        existing.crm_principal_id = $5
                        AND existing.source = 'EMAIL_MATCH'::crm_user_mapping_source
                    )
               )
             LIMIT 1
